dashboard.label: Isovalent + Tenable Dev
dashboard.description: Development dashboard for seeded Isovalent runtime events and Tenable Cloud Security findings. Demo HEC events use source=demo-tenable-correlation on both indexes; native Tenable integration uses source=Ermetic.

search.query: index=cisco_security_cloud sourcetype=cisco:isovalent:* source=demo-tenable-correlation | eval cluster=coalesce(cluster, 'cluster-name') | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | stats count

index=tenable (source=Ermetic OR source=demo-tenable-correlation) type=Finding | rex field=resources{} "cluster/(?<cluster>[^/\"]+)" | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | dedup id | stats count

index=tenable source=demo-tenable-correlation type=Finding status=Open | rex field=resources{} "cluster/(?<cluster>[^/\"]+)" | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | dedup id | stats count

index=cisco_security_cloud sourcetype=cisco:isovalent:* source=demo-tenable-correlation | eval cluster=coalesce(cluster, 'cluster-name') | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | stats count as isovalent_events by cluster | join cluster [ search index=tenable (source=Ermetic OR source=demo-tenable-correlation) type=Finding status=Open | rex field=resources{} "cluster/(?<cluster>[^/\"]+)" | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | dedup id | stats count as tenable_findings by cluster ] | where isovalent_events>0 AND tenable_findings>0 | stats count

index=cisco_security_cloud sourcetype=cisco:isovalent:* source=demo-tenable-correlation | eval cluster=coalesce(cluster, 'cluster-name') | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | timechart span=1h count by sourcetype

index=tenable (source=Ermetic OR source=demo-tenable-correlation) type=Finding | rex field=resources{} "cluster/(?<cluster>[^/\"]+)" | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | dedup id | timechart span=1h count by severity

index=cisco_security_cloud sourcetype=cisco:isovalent:* source=demo-tenable-correlation | eval cluster=coalesce(cluster, 'cluster-name') | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | stats count by cluster, sourcetype

index=tenable (source=Ermetic OR source=demo-tenable-correlation) type=Finding status=Open | rex field=resources{} "cluster/(?<cluster>[^/\"]+)" | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | dedup id | stats count by cluster, severity

index=cisco_security_cloud sourcetype=cisco:isovalent:* source=demo-tenable-correlation | eval cluster=coalesce(cluster, 'cluster-name') | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | stats count as isovalent_events, values(sourcetype) as isovalent_sourcetypes by cluster | join cluster type=outer [ search index=tenable (source=Ermetic OR source=demo-tenable-correlation) type=Finding status=Open | rex field=resources{} "cluster/(?<cluster>[^/\"]+)" | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | dedup id | stats count as tenable_open_findings, values(title) as tenable_titles, values(severity) as tenable_severities, values(source) as tenable_sources by cluster ] | eval correlated=if(isovalent_events>0 AND tenable_open_findings>0, "yes", "no") | sort - isovalent_events - tenable_open_findings | table cluster, isovalent_events, isovalent_sourcetypes, tenable_open_findings, tenable_sources, tenable_severities, correlated, tenable_titles

index=cisco_security_cloud sourcetype=cisco:isovalent:* source=demo-tenable-correlation | eval cluster=coalesce(cluster, 'cluster-name') | spath path=event.process_exec.process.pod.namespace output=ns_alert | spath path=process_exec.process.pod.namespace output=ns_exec | spath path=process_connect.process.pod.namespace output=ns_conn | spath path=event.process_exec.process.pod.workload output=wl_alert | spath path=process_exec.process.pod.workload output=wl_exec | spath path=process_connect.process.pod.workload output=wl_conn | spath path=rule.name output=alert_name | spath path=process_exec.process.pod.container.image output=image | eval namespace=coalesce(ns_alert, ns_exec, ns_conn, kubernetes_namespace) | eval workload=coalesce(wl_alert, wl_exec, wl_conn, kubernetes_workload_name) | eval alert=coalesce(alert_name, "n/a") | eval image=coalesce(image, "n/a") | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | table _time, sourcetype, cluster, namespace, workload, host, alert, image | sort - _time

index=tenable (source=Ermetic OR source=demo-tenable-correlation) type=Finding status=Open | rex field=resources{} "cluster/(?<cluster>[^/\"]+)" | rex field=resources{} "cluster/[^/]+/(?<namespace>[^/]+)/(?<workload_kind>[^/]+)/(?<workload_name>[^\"]+)" | rex field=resourceNames{} "^(?<ns_from_name>[^|]+)\s*\|\s*(?<wl_from_name>[^|]+)" | eval namespace=coalesce(namespace, ns_from_name) | eval workload_name=coalesce(workload_name, wl_from_name) | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | dedup id | table _time, source, severity, title, cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload_name, accountName, cloudProvider, description, link | sort - _time

index=tenable (source=Ermetic OR source=demo-tenable-correlation) type=Finding status=Open | rex field=resources{} "cluster/(?<cluster_path>[^/\"]+)" | rex field=resources{} ":cluster/(?<cluster_arn>[^/\"]+)" | rex field=resources{} "cluster/[^/]+/(?<namespace_path>[^/]+)/(?<workload_kind>[^/]+)/(?<workload_path>[^\"]+)" | rex field=resourceNames{} "^(?<cluster_name>[^|]+)" | rex field=resourceNames{} "^\s*(?<namespace_name>[^|]+)\s*\|\s*(?<workload_name>[^|]+)" | rex field=description "(?i)EKS Cluster (?<cluster_desc>[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)" | rex field=description "(?i)^(?<namespace_desc>[^|]+)\s*\|\s*(?<workload_desc>[^ ]+)" | rex field=description "(?i)(?<workload_img>eks-pod-identity-agent|kube-proxy|coredns|aws-network-policy-agent)" | eval cluster=coalesce(cluster_path, cluster_arn, cluster_name, cluster_desc) | eval namespace=trim(coalesce(namespace_path, namespace_name, namespace_desc, "kube-system")) | eval workload=coalesce(workload_path, workload_name, workload_desc, workload_img, "(cluster-level)") | where isnotnull(cluster) | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | dedup id | stats count as open_findings values(title) as findings values(severity) as severities values(description) as descriptions values(cloudProvider) as cloud_provider values(accountName) as account values(namespace) as namespaces sum(eval(if(source="Ermetic",1,0))) as native_cloud_security_findings sum(eval(if(source="demo-tenable-correlation",1,0))) as demo_hec_findings values(link) as tenable_links by cluster workload | join cluster workload type=outer [ search index=cisco_security_cloud sourcetype=cisco:isovalent:* earliest=$time.earliest$ latest=$time.latest$ | eval cluster=coalesce(cluster, 'cluster-name') | spath path=process_exec.process.pod.namespace output=ns_exec | spath path=event.process_exec.process.pod.namespace output=ns_alert | spath path=process_exec.process.pod.workload output=wl_exec | spath path=event.process_exec.process.pod.workload output=wl_alert | spath path=process_exec.process.pod.container.image output=container_image | spath path=rule.name output=alert_name | eval workload=coalesce(wl_exec, wl_alert, kubernetes_workload_name) | where isnotnull(workload) | where if("$cluster$"="*", 1=1, cluster="$cluster$") | stats count as isovalent_events values(sourcetype) as isovalent_event_types values(alert_name) as isovalent_alerts values(container_image) as runtime_images values(coalesce(ns_exec, ns_alert, kubernetes_namespace)) as isovalent_namespaces dc(host) as nodes_observed by cluster workload ] | eval open_findings=coalesce(open_findings, 0) | eval isovalent_events=coalesce(isovalent_events, 0) | eval correlated=case(open_findings>0 AND isovalent_events>0, "posture+runtime", open_findings>0, "posture-only", isovalent_events>0, "runtime-only", true(), "unknown") | sort - open_findings - isovalent_events | table cluster workload correlated open_findings findings severities namespaces native_cloud_security_findings demo_hec_findings cloud_provider account isovalent_events isovalent_event_types isovalent_alerts runtime_images isovalent_namespaces nodes_observed descriptions tenable_links
